text:
ashley: quick note — seeing sustained KV cache resident set growth on Dedicated after multi-turn 10k token dialogs. memory climbs then plateaus ~20-30% higher than Hosted.

satoshi: can you paste the profiling run? which kernel & driver? MTU settings?

ashley: test harness: host=dedicated-5, nvidia-driver=510.47, kernel=5.15, batching=dynamic (window=6ms), kv-config: slot_size=64MB, page_threshold=0.7

leo: interesting — on Hosted we've consistently had tighter eviction defaults (page_threshold ~0.55). Did you run with the same attention kernels / quantization path?

ashley: ran two permutations: cuBLAS path vs fused-attn. fused-attn reduces per-token latency but shows more fragmentation and long-context memory growth. sample excerpt from perf log:

```
KV: pages_alloc=18432 pages_active=16210 page_faults=243
frag_ratio=0.18 reuse_hit=0.74
perf: avg_latency=43ms tail99=210ms
```

charlie: @ashley can you try page_threshold=0.55 to force earlier eviction and compare tail99 and re-loads?

ashley: did that earlier today — earlier eviction drops resident memory ~18% but increases page reloads and hurts throughput (~12% drop). tradeoff chart is messy but consistent across runs. infra-bot flagged an OOM on run #2.

infra-bot: perf-test job #742 failed: OOM on dedicated-5 during second run.

satoshi: could VPC constraints be contributing? Dedicated runs inside customer VPCs sometimes have MTU=1500, no jumbo frames, which slows large page migration paths. On-prem GPUs show higher page-fault syscall overhead in our traces.

ops: on Private/on-prem we also observed jemalloc flags and hugepage alignment affecting slab fragmentation. small change to arena alignment dropped frag_ratio by ~0.06 in one lab cluster. recommend an opt-in hugepage alignment knob for onprem package.

leo: we should capture kernel selection per request and correlate to pagewalk latency. also want heatmaps: batching-window vs reuse-hit vs frag_ratio.

charlie: action items: (1) @ashley reproduce across kernel 5.10 and 5.15, (2) add short-term tracing PR to annotate pagewalk lat and kernel chosen, (3) run page_threshold matrix {0.55,0.65,0.75} across Hosted/Dedicated/Private, (4) ops to validate jemalloc & hugepage settings on onprem testbed.

ashley: quick repro command I'm using: 

```
./run_kv_stress --model=t5x --tokens=12000 --batcher=dynamic --window=6
```

leo: ack. i'll add kernel-selection metrics to the runtime tracer this afternoon.

ashley: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
